note: Brent and WTI turned back up on 16 Oct after CENTCOM said the US and partners control the Strait of Hormuz, even as JMIC counted US-facilitated transits at only about a fifth of the pre-war rate, and drones hit two more tankers off Romania's Black Sea coast. TTF set a fresh 2026 high as the Trump administration weighed easing shadow-fleet tanker sanctions to relieve record freight rates. Henry Hub was little changed, insulated from the turmoil.
